# Layout

See [Grid and Layout guidelines<i className="ds-icon-launch"></i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/visual-styles/grid/)

## Utilities

- <LinkTo kind="Components/Container" story="docs">Container</LinkTo> : main layout element with fluid or fixed width
- <LinkTo kind="Components/Flex" story="docs">Flex</LinkTo> : component simplifying usage of the css flexbox model
- <LinkTo kind="Components/Grid" story="docs">Grid</LinkTo> : 12-column grid system
- <LinkTo kind="Components/Hidden" story="docs">Hidden</LinkTo> : utility for hiding elements by breakpoint
- <LinkTo kind="Components/Inline" story="docs">Inline</LinkTo> : render a set of components in a row with equal spacing
- <LinkTo kind="Components/Stack" story="docs">Stack</LinkTo> : render a set of components in a column with equal spacing

The advantage of using the `Inline` or `Stack` components is that they allow to manage fixed spacing values between children.

## Breakpoints

In responsive design, breakpoints define screen sizes where layouts and interfaces may change
to adapt to different devices.

With a grid based on a unit of 8px, we defined for each breakpoint

- Content area : width of the main page Content
- Columns : number of columns
- Gutter : spacing between columns

| Name | Screen width | Content area | Columns | Gutter |
| ---- | ------------ | ------------ | ------- | ------ |
| xxs  | 320px        | 304px        | 2       | 16px   |
| xs   | 480px        | 432px        | 4       | 24px   |
| sm   | 768px        | 736px        | 6       | 32px   |
| md   | 960px        | 928px        | 6       | 32px   |
| lg   | 1200px       | 1120px       | 12      | 32px   |
| xl   | 1440px       | 1408px       | 12      | 32px   |
| xxl  | 1920px       | 1760px       | 12      | 32px   |
